name: Google Messages for Desktop
tagline: Google Messages for web as a dedicated desktop app
pitch: A FOSS Electron wrapper for Google Messages for web on Windows, macOS, and Linux: native window, tray unread badge, OS notifications, and sms:/tel:/im: protocol compose without UA spoofing.
features: Electron shell for messages.google.com/web with persist:main auth
Windows/macOS/Linux packaging via electron-builder and GitHub Releases
sms:, tel:, smsto:, callto:, and im: protocol compose
System tray unread red-dot and unfocused OS toasts on Windows
FOSS MIT; no Cloud Agents; Venmo donate link in Help/About/README
quick_start: Clone the repo and open it in Cursor Desktop (This Computer only).
Follow docs/START_HERE.md, then npm --prefix electron run dev.
Pair your phone at messages.google.com/web. Tray icon appears near the clock when Enable Tray Icon is on.
install: Requires Node 20+ for packaging. Windows/macOS/Linux unsigned smoke builds ship on GitHub Releases (v1.8.1+). Prefer HUMAN-signed installers for production.
usage: Use /verify before merge and /ship to publish. Product README at repo root is canonical — do not overwrite it with generate-project-readme.py. Branding metadata lives in branding/product.json.
